_why: Arcane's redesign is a Mana Shield spec, and the premade build buys none
of it -- every talent involved sits in the defensive column a raid arcane
mage walks past.
Arcane Stability 5/5 Arcane Missiles has a chance to reset Invocation.
Invocation halves spell cost and adds spell power,
and Arcane Attunement (Magic Attunement, kept at
2/2 below) refunds double the cost of anything cast
inside it -- so resetting it is a mana *gain*. This
is the loop the woa arcane rotation exists to feed.
Arcane Fortitude 3/3 armour from intellect, and scales the Mana Shield
absorb by the same.
Prismatic Shields 2/2  Mana Shield also reduces damage taken.
Magic Absorption 2/2 hits taken under Mana Shield roll the mage's crit
chance to land at half damage.
Prismatic Cloak 3/3  a flat 18% reduction of all damage taken, up from
retail's 6%. Unconditional, and the largest single
survivability number in the tree.
Funded by leaving both off-trees entirely:
Fire 3 (Incineration) and Frost 12 (Frostbite, Ice Floes, Ice Shards,
Precision, Icy Veins). 15 points of raid throughput and one cooldown,
spent instead on not dying. Precision's hit rating is the real loss and
is the first thing to revisit if the sim shows misses rather than deaths.
Focus Magic goes too, as in the other two builds, and Torment the Weak
with it: arcane has no snare of its own, so its condition is never met
solo. The freed points buy Incanter's Absorption 3/3, which converts
absorbed damage into spell power and so pays the Mana Shield package
back as throughput rather than only as survival.
71 Arcane.
